g.text: execution role — ECR pull, log streams
1 Visitor resolves the record and connects over HTTPS.
2 The Web ACL inspects the request before the load balancer;
.. a blocked request is answered 403 at the edge.
4 Port 80 redirects to 443, which terminates TLS with the ACM cert.
5 authenticate-cognito: without a valid session the visitor is sent to
.. the hosted UI, the code is exchanged, the session cookie is set and
.. identity headers are added to the request.
6 The authenticated request is forwarded to the target group.
7 The target group reaches the task ENI on :80 — the nginx container.
8 nginx proxies to the backend on :8000, carrying X-Request-Id
.. so both log groups can be correlated.
